root: ^Good morning! You must be Chemy, the new alchemist!
^I'm Poshe! I deliver the newspaper every morning.
^Welcome to Wavecrest! Here's the Daily Tidals.
^Oh, Poshe! I've heard about you from Mr. Tidus. What's this 'Daily Tidals' about?
^Daily Tidals is the name of our newspaper! Besides the daily news happening in all of A'ea, it also lists commision requests from the townspeople.
^Please do some commision whenever you feel up to it. It would help out a ton! I'm sure everybody would appreciate it.
^I still have more newspapers to deliver. Have a great day, Chemy!
^I should try help out around town. Let's see what's in today's paper...
